scripts.text:
[Hairdresser Jovovich]
Welcome~!
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[发型师 乔沃维奇]
欢迎光临~！
请问有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[Hairdresser Jovovich]
Eh!? Oh my! Oh no no no no! Your hair is sooo damaged! It's not good if you leave your hair like this.
scripts.translation:
[发型师 乔沃维奇]
哎呀！？天哪！不行不行不行！
您的头发受损得太严重了！
这样放着不管可不好。

scripts.text:
[Hairdresser Jovovich]
Oh, no! Your hair is damaged. It seems as if you may need professional treatment. Come sit over here, please. Come.
scripts.translation:
[发型师 乔沃维奇]
哎呀，您的头发受损了！
看来得做专业护理才行。
来，请坐这边，请坐。

scripts.text:
[Hairdresser Jovovich]
Wow! Your hair would be perfect once it's dyed~ How about dying your hair for a change?
scripts.translation:
[发型师 乔沃维奇]
哇！您的头发染个颜色就完美了~
要不要换个发色，换换心情？

scripts.text:
[Hairdresser Jovovich]
Would you let me treat your hair? Please?
scripts.translation:
[发型师 乔沃维奇]
让我为您护理一下头发，好不好？
拜托啦！

scripts.text: Dye Hair
scripts.translation: 染发

scripts.text: Tips and Information
scripts.translation: 染发须知

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Hairdresser Jovovich]
Yes yes, good choice~
Well then, this is your chance for a make-over, your chance to blossom in beauty! Choose the color you would like.
scripts.translation:
[发型师 乔沃维奇]
好好好，选得好~
让自己焕然一新、绽放美丽的机会来啦！
请选择您喜欢的颜色。

scripts.text:
[Hairdresser Jovovich]
What do you think? Did you want a different color?
scripts.translation:
[发型师 乔沃维奇]
您觉得怎么样？
还想试试别的颜色吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Hairdresser Jovovich]
Okay! Choose the color that you would like.
scripts.translation:
[发型师 乔沃维奇]
好的！
请选择您喜欢的颜色。

scripts.text:
[Hairdresser Jovovich]
Hmm, I'm sort of disappointed. I wanted to do a better job. But I promise I'll do it better next time. Please come again~
scripts.translation:
[发型师 乔沃维奇]
嗯，有点遗憾呢。
我原本还想做得更好些。
不过我保证，下次一定让您更满意。
记得再来哦~

scripts.text: Red, please.
scripts.translation: 染红色

scripts.text: Yellow, please.
scripts.translation: 染黄色

scripts.text: Violet, please.
scripts.translation: 染紫色

scripts.text: Orange, please.
scripts.translation: 染橙色

scripts.text: Green, please.
scripts.translation: 染绿色

scripts.text: Blue, please.
scripts.translation: 染蓝色

scripts.text: White, please.
scripts.translation: 染白色

scripts.text: Black, please.
scripts.translation: 染黑色

scripts.text: Actually, I like my hair as it is.
scripts.translation: 其实，我觉得现在的发色就很好

scripts.text:
[Hairdresser Jovovich]
You must like your hair color~
scripts.translation:
[发型师 乔沃维奇]
看来您很喜欢现在的发色~

scripts.text:
[Hairdresser Jovovich]
Eehh~? You're not going to dye your hair? I'm a little sad...
scripts.translation:
[发型师 乔沃维奇]
诶~？您不打算染发了吗？
我有点难过...

scripts.text:
[Hairdresser Jovovich]
Eh? But that's the hair color you already have. Please choose a different color.
scripts.translation:
[发型师 乔沃维奇]
诶？这不就是您现在的发色吗？
请选择别的颜色吧。

scripts.text:
[Hairdresser Jovovich]
The fee is 1000 zeny. Do you not have enough...?
scripts.translation:
[发型师 乔沃维奇]
费用是1000 Zeny。
您带的钱不够吗...？

scripts.text:
[Hairdresser Jovovich]
When you're feeling down , when you get dumped, when you want to impress someone, or even when you just want to stand out...
scripts.translation:
[发型师 乔沃维奇]
心情低落的时候，失恋的时候，想给谁留下深刻印象的时候，或是单纯想引人注目的时候...

scripts.text:
[Hairdresser Jovovich]
For that special place and time, wouldn't you want a hairstyle of your very own? As long as you have the appropriate dyestuffs, I will make your hair look wonderful.
scripts.translation:
[发型师 乔沃维奇]
在特别的时刻、特别的场合，难道不想拥有属于自己的发型吗？
只要带来合适的染料，我就能让您的秀发光彩照人。

scripts.text:
[Hairdresser Jovovich]
And try not to worry too much about the fee. Acquiring beauty is the same as acquiring everything. Hehe~
scripts.translation:
[发型师 乔沃维奇]
至于费用，就别太放在心上啦。
拥有了美丽，就等于拥有了一切。
呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Hairdresser Jovovich]
* Fees and Information *
- 1 Dyestuffs item of the color of hair you want.
- 1000 zeny fee.
scripts.translation:
[发型师 乔沃维奇]
* 费用与须知 *
- 所选发色对应的染料1个
- 费用1000 Zeny

scripts.text:
[Hairdresser Jovovich]
Men or Women...
Everyone has the right and obligation to be beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[发型师 乔沃维奇]
无论男女...每个人都有变美的权利和义务。

scripts.text:
[Hairdresser Jovovich]
Eh?! But you need the item '{0}' to dye your hair {1}...
scripts.translation:
[发型师 乔沃维奇]
诶？！得先有物品“{0}”，才能把头发染成{1}...
